name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 2
summary: Applied Digital AI data center campus near Harwood in Cass County, North Dakota, on more than 900 acres. Announced in August 2025 as a 3 billion US dollar, 280 MW project, it was later described as a 1 GW campus. An unnamed US investment-grade hyperscaler leased the first 200 MW of critical IT load in two buildings for about 15 years and holds a right of first refusal on 800 MW more. Construction is funded partly by 2.15 billion US dollars of senior secured notes issued in March 2026; the company expects initial operations by the end of 2026 and the full 200 MW in 2027.
